settings.keys: F6 settings · F8 force feedback off

ffb.label: Force feedback
ffb.help: F8 turns it off at any time.

ffb.label: Strength
ffb.help: How heavy the wheel feels. Lower it for strong wheels.

ffb.label: Crash strength
ffb.help: How hard crashes hit, when crash kicks are on.

ffb.label: Reverse direction
ffb.help: Turn on if the wheel pulls away from center.

cameras.text: Drive to adjust the current camera.

cameras.label: Field of view
cameras.help: Zoom for the bonnet or bumper camera you drive in.

cameras.label: Bonnet camera
cameras.help: Adds a hood view to the game's camera cycle.

cameras.label: Bumper camera
cameras.help: Adds a bumper view to the game's camera cycle.

cameras.label: Camera keys
cameras.help: Numpad moves the camera, + and - zoom, 5 resets.

telemetry.label: Telemetry
telemetry.help: Live car data for dashboard apps such as SimHub.

help.label: Report a problem
help.help: Saves a report file you can read before sharing it.
